claim: Stem asserts the 2020-21 Super Lig title 'was decided on goal difference'. claim: Stem says 'The English top-flight record of seven goals by one player in a single match was set in 1935' by Ted Drake. Drake equalled rather than set it: James Ross scored seven for Preston North End against Stoke in the First Division in October 1888. Seven is the joint top-flight record, first achieved in 1888, so the temporal claim 'set in 1935' is untrue.
q: The English top-flight record of seven goals by one player in a single match was set in 1935 by which Arsenal forward?

q: Fenerbahçe fans gave legend Lefter Küçükandonyadis which nickname, a title normally reserved for distinguished professors?

q: When Roma handed Totti the captaincy in 1998, he became the youngest club captain in Serie A history, at what age?
